```{python}
# Setup code
import pandas as pd
from python_scripts import setup
from python_scripts import services
from python_scripts import helper
df, dffp = setup.setup(verbose=False)

from python_scripts import distinct_pathways
dpw_pls = distinct_pathways.get_distinct_pathways_routes(dffp)
qrows = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] == "[Not ended or invalid end reason]"
dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "pl_end_dt"].isna().map({True: "[Not ended]", False: "Missing data/error"})
dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"].str.replace("To care/hosp.", "To care/hospital")
dpw_rt_starts = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").head(1)
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").tail(1)
dpw_clis = dpw_pls.groupby(["o_cli_id"]).head(1)  # 1 duplicate client but first entry has more detailed answers

import matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
matplotlib.rcParams.update({
    'figure.figsize': (6.2, 4.1),
    'font.size': 12,
    'figure.constrained_layout.use': True
})

asset_themes = {"opaque": "assets_output/",
                "transparent_lightbg": "assets_transparent_lightbg/",
                "transparent_darkbg": "assets_transparent_darkbg/"}
assets_output = asset_themes["opaque"]
output_dir = assets_output
transparent = False
excel_output = {}
```

## Social housing returns

```{python}
soc_moves = dpw_pls[dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] == "To social housing"]
# soc_move_type: "BCC" or "RSL" depending on end reason for last placement in route
soc_move_type = (soc_moves.groupby("route_id").tail(1)
                  .set_index("route_id")
                  ["pl_end_reason"].str[0:3]
                  .rename("soc_move_type")
                  .replace({"BCC": "Local authority", "RSL": "Housing association"})
                  .astype("category"))
dpw_pls = dpw_pls.join(soc_move_type, on="route_id")
dpw_rt_starts = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").head(1)
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").tail(1)
dpw_clis = dpw_pls.groupby(["o_cli_id"]).head(1)  # 1 duplicate client but first entry has more detailed answers
tbl = dpw_rt_ends[["rt_end_cat", "soc_move_type"]].value_counts().to_frame()
excel_output["Social housing returns"] = tbl
display(tbl)
```

## Durations for social housing outcomes: distributions

```{python}
#| output: false
import numpy as np
import seaborn as sns
import seaborn.objects as so
sns.set()
# Set up data
#############
durations = dpw_pls.set_index("route_id")[["dur", "pl_start_dt"]]
durations["dur_days"] = durations["dur"].dt.days
durations["dur_days"] = durations["dur_days"].fillna(1 + (distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt - durations.pl_start_dt).dt.days)
durations = durations.drop(columns=["dur", "pl_start_dt"])
hist_data = (
    durations.groupby(level=0).dur_days.sum().to_frame()
    .join(dpw_rt_ends.set_index("route_id")["pl_end_dt"].notna().rename("ended").astype("category"))
    .join(dpw_rt_ends.set_index("route_id")[["rt_end_cat", "soc_move_type"]])
)
hist_data = hist_data[hist_data["rt_end_cat"] == "To social housing"]
hist_data = hist_data.drop(columns="rt_end_cat")
hist_data = pd.concat([hist_data, hist_data.assign(soc_move_type="All")])
hist_data["ended"] = pd.Categorical(hist_data["ended"], categories=[True, False], ordered=True)
hist_data["dur_years"] = hist_data["dur_days"] / 365.25
colours = sns.color_palette(as_cmap=False)
# Calculate positions of separators between groups for log unit labels
days_logunits = {"day": 1, "week": 7, "month": 365.25/12, "year": 365.25}
days_loglists = {
    "days": [1, 2, 4],
    "weeks": [1, 2],
    "months": [1, 2, 4, 8],
    "years": [1, 2, 4, 8, 16]
}
days_logsep = []
for (a_u, a_l), (b_u, b_l) in zip(list(days_loglists.items())[:-1], list(days_loglists.items())[1:]):
    a_end = days_logunits[a_u[:-1]] * a_l[-1]
    b_start = days_logunits[b_u[:-1]] * b_l[0]
    log_midpoint = 10 ** ((np.log10(a_end) + np.log10(b_start))/2)
    days_logsep.append(log_midpoint)
# Calculate positions of group labels for log units
days_loggrp_edges = [0.8] + days_logsep + [30 * days_logunits["year"]]
days_logpos_grp = list(10 ** ((np.log10(a) + np.log10(b))/2) for a, b in zip(days_loggrp_edges[:-1], days_loggrp_edges[1:]))
# Calculate order for facets
facet_order = ["All", "Local authority", "Housing association"]
# Generate human-readable units and tick positions for log timescales
#####################################################################
days_logunits = {"day": 1, "week": 7, "month": 365.25/12, "year": 365.25}
days_loglists = {
    "weeks": [1],
    "months": [1, 4],
    "years": [1, 3, 9]
}
days_logscale = []
days_loglabels_u = []
days_loglabels_full = []
days_loglabels_grp = []
for u, l in days_loglists.items():
    days_logscale.extend(days_logunits[u[:-1]] * i for i in l)
    # days_loglabels_u.extend(l)
    days_loglabels_u.extend(f"{x}{u[0]}" for x in l)
    days_loglabels_full.extend(f"{i} {u if i > 1 else u[:-1]}" for i in l)
    days_loglabels_grp.append(u)
days_logformatter = matplotlib.ticker.FixedFormatter(days_loglabels_u)
# Plot log scale charts
#######################
limits = {"x": (0.014*365.25, 10*365.25), "y": (None, 100)}
fig = plt.figure(layout="constrained", figsize=(4.2, 4.1))
subfigs = fig.subfigures(1, 2, width_ratios=[7, 6])
p = (
    so.Plot(data=hist_data, x="dur_years")
    .label(x="Duration (years)")
    .add(so.Bars(), so.Hist(binwidth=0.5), so.Stack(), color="ended", legend=False)
    .scale(x=so.Continuous().tick(every=2),
           color=so.Nominal(order=[True, False]))
    .facet(row="soc_move_type", order=facet_order)
    .limit(x=(0, 10))
    .on(subfigs[0])
    .plot()
)
p = (
    so.Plot(data=hist_data, x="dur_days")
    .label(x="Duration (log scale)")
    .add(so.Bars(), so.Hist(bins=20), so.Stack(), color="ended", legend=False)
    .scale(x=so.Continuous(trans="log").tick(at=days_logscale).label(formatter=days_logformatter),
           color=so.Nominal(order=[True, False]))
    .facet(row="soc_move_type", order=facet_order)
    .limit(x=limits["x"])
    .on(subfigs[1])
    .plot()
)
for ax in subfigs[1].axes:
    ax.yaxis.set_tick_params(labelleft=False)
fig_filename = "Figure_1.1.svg"
fig.savefig(output_dir + fig_filename, transparent=transparent)
plt.show()
```

## Durations for social housing outcomes: descriptive statistics

```{python}
tbl_data = hist_data.copy()
# tbl_data = hist_data[["ended", "dur_years"]]
percentiles = [0.1, 0.5, 0.9]
tbl = (tbl_data.groupby("soc_move_type", observed=True).describe(percentiles=percentiles)
       .sort_index())
tbl = tbl.astype("object")
int_cols = {"dur_days": ["count", "min", "max"], "dur_years": ["count"]}
float_cols = {k: tbl.columns.levels[1].difference(v) for k, v in int_cols.items()}
float_prec = {"dur_days": 1, "dur_years": 3}
for dt in ["dur_days", "dur_years"]:
    fp = float_prec[dt]
    tbl.loc[:, (dt, float_cols[dt])] = (tbl.loc[:, (dt, float_cols[dt])].map(lambda x: f"{x:,.{fp}f}"))
    tbl.loc[:, (dt, int_cols[dt])] = (tbl.loc[:, (dt, int_cols[dt])].map(lambda x: f"{x:,.0f}"))
tbl = (
    tbl.T.reindex((a, b)
                    for a in ["dur_years", "dur_days"]
                    for b in [x for x in tbl["dur_days"].columns if x != "count"] + ["count"]).T
    .rename(columns={"50%": "median"})
)
tbl = pd.concat([tbl["dur_years"], tbl["dur_days"]], keys=["Years", "Days"])
excel_output["Table 1.1: Descriptive statistics for route durations by social housing move type"] = tbl
display(tbl)
```

## Returns at periods of time after exit by social housing type: table

```{python}
# Generate table
stable_periods = {x: f"after_rt_ret_within_{x}" for x in distinct_pathways.stable_offsets.keys()}
stable_period_max_end_dts = {x: distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt - distinct_pathways.stable_offsets[x]
                             for x in distinct_pathways.stable_offsets.keys()}
soc_move_grp = (pd.concat([dpw_rt_ends,
                           (dpw_rt_ends[dpw_rt_ends["rt_end_cat"] == "To social housing"]
                            .assign(soc_move_type="All"))
                           ])
                .groupby("soc_move_type"))
route_outcomes = soc_move_grp.size().rename(("outcomes", "n")).to_frame()
route_outcomes[("outcomes", "%")] = (100*route_outcomes[("outcomes", "n")]
                                     / route_outcomes[("outcomes", "n")].sum())
for k, v in stable_periods.items():
    route_outcomes[k, f"Eligible (n)"] = (soc_move_grp["pl_end_dt"]
                                 .apply(lambda x: (x < stable_period_max_end_dts[k]).sum()).astype("Int64"))
    for outcome in ["Yes", "No"]:
        route_outcomes[k, outcome] = (soc_move_grp
                                      .apply(lambda x: ((x["pl_end_dt"] < stable_period_max_end_dts[k])
                                                        & (x[v] == outcome)).sum()).astype("Int64"))
    route_outcomes[k, "% returned"] = (route_outcomes[k, "Yes"]
                                       .mul(100).div(route_outcomes[k, "Yes"]
                                                     + route_outcomes[k, "No"]))
    route_outcomes = route_outcomes.drop(columns=(k, "No"))
    route_outcomes = route_outcomes.rename(columns={"Yes": "Returned (n)"}, level=1)
na_cols = ["[Not ended]", "Died"]
tbl_n = route_outcomes.iloc[:, :2]
tbl_periods = (route_outcomes.astype("object")
               .loc[[x for x in route_outcomes.index.to_list() if x not in na_cols]]
               .iloc[:, 2:].stack(sort=False))
tbl = tbl_periods
tbl.index = tbl.index.set_names(("End reason", "Statistic"))
with pd.option_context("display.float_format", "{:,.1f}".format):
    display(tbl)

excel_output["Table 1.2: Returns at periods of time after exit by social housing moves"] = tbl
```
## Returns at periods of time after exit by social housing type: charts

```{python}
#| output: false
# Plot chart
import matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import seaborn.objects as so
periodMult = {"d": 1, "m": 365.25/12, "y": 365.25}
periodYears = {x: int(x[:-1]) * periodMult[x[-1]] / periodMult["y"] for x in distinct_pathways.stable_offsets.keys()}
plotdata = (
    tbl.unstack(0).loc["% returned"].reset_index(1)
    .assign(years=lambda x: x.index.map(periodYears))
    .reset_index()
)
zeroes = pd.DataFrame({"index": "", "End reason": plotdata["End reason"].unique(), "% returned": 0, "years": 0},
                      index=range(len(plotdata), len(plotdata) + plotdata["End reason"].nunique()))
plotdata = pd.concat([zeroes, plotdata])
facet_order = tbl_n.index.to_list()


def cust_plot(rc_params={}, annot_color="black"):
    return (
        so.Plot(data=plotdata, y="% returned", x="years", text="index")
        .facet("End reason", wrap=4, order=facet_order)
        .label(x="", y="")
        .add(so.Dot(), data=plotdata[plotdata["index"] != ""])
        .add(so.Line())
        .add(so.Area(edgewidth=0))
        .limit(x=(0, 5), y=(0, None))
        .scale(x=(so.Continuous()
                  .tick(every=1, minor=0)
                  .label(like=lambda x, pos: f"{x:.0f}" if x != 5 else "5y")),
              y=so.Continuous().tick(minor=1).label(unit=("", "%")))
        .theme({"axes.grid.which": "both"} | rc_params)
        .layout(size=(6.2, 2.1), engine="constrained")
    )


fig_filename = "Figure_1.2.svg"
p = cust_plot()
p.save(output_dir + fig_filename, transparent=transparent)
p.show(block=False)
```
![](`{python} output_dir + fig_filename`)

#### Thoughts:
- Local authority may be "landlord of last resort", i.e. its statutory duties
  may incentivise it to accept people who may be less likely to succeed.
- Housing association caution (e.g. assessments, skipping, affordability
  checks) may reduce likelihood of failure at cost of lower letting rates.

## Tables in an Excel file

```{python}
#| output: asis
import os
sheetname = "Sheet1"
qmdfile = os.getenv("QUARTO_DOCUMENT_FILE")
filename = assets_output + qmdfile[:-4]+".xlsx"
with pd.ExcelWriter(filename) as writer:
    next_row = 0
    for k, v in excel_output.items():
        pd.DataFrame([k]).to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheetname, header=False, index=False, startrow=next_row)
        next_row += 1
        v.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheetname, startrow=next_row, float_format="%.1f")
        next_row += (
            (1 if not isinstance(v.columns, pd.MultiIndex) else 1 + len(v.columns.levels))
            + len(v) + 1)
print(f"[Excel file](./{filename})")
```
